profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Loudoun County Public Schools
profile.summary: Excellent IT experience specializing in software testing, repackaging, and 3rd level support of all software deployments in the Enterprise. Image development, maintenance, implementation and documentation of standard workstation, laptop, and server configurations with a detail oriented focus. Experience includes: Twenty years with Microsoft operating systems and Active Directory implementation; five years with Macintosh computer systems; over five years in the computer networking/telecom industry; sixteen years in customer service/technical support - 1st, 2nd, and 3rd level; training and support of end users; outstanding oral and written communication skills which complement my technical abilities.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
 Image creation, maintenance, and deployment as needed.
 Coordinated with systems and network teams to identify and remedy user environment issues.
 Creation of specialized software packages as needed, including testing and remediation.
 Responsible for development, configuration, deployment and documentation of server based applications.
 Assisted in in development of Active Directory Group Policies and permission sets for both Windows XP and Windows 7, in conjunction with current Engineering Teams and end users.
 Partnered with vendors to identify issues and address concerns.
 Standardized software packages for deployment, and provided 3rd level technical support for over 400 software titles currently in use.
 Tested new hardware platforms to ensure compatibility with existing software environment as well as providing workarounds and recommendations.
 Supported projects to migrate from Windows XP to Windows 7, and Office 2007 to 2010.
 Documentation of software including installation instructions, configuration, and licensing.
 Test new software titles to ensure stability and usability.
 Responsible for Windows patch management utilizing WSUS.
